segments.text: V. 36. Ye may perhaps think, GOD does not ſo much regard your Words. But I ſay to you—That not for blaſphemous and profane Words only, but for every ille word which men ſeall ſpeak—For Want of Seriouſneſs or Caution, for every Diſcourſe which is not conducive to the Glory of GOD, they ſhall give account in the day of judgment.
